body:
Slot priority, from Fable2 #4801 on 2026-11-07, under Greg's EO-first word.
- Central: every free slot goes FIRST to the EO lane, in this order: w-7ebf (30 s bound), then w-37d9's checks, then w-8f4c, if it needs Central. Phoenix and the other work come after.
- DL560 Codex 7: an EO focused job or EO evidence transfer goes ahead of the non-EO focused jobs (w-2050, w-f5bb).
- Don't stop a non-EO run that's already running; let it finish.
